body: Proposed a single bulk upsert on group_stats with onConflict contract_id; tests with 50 groups spying on fetch. Crypto payout address included.
Resolved in PR #85: migration with a reconcile_group_states RPC doing one bulk UPDATE, returns missing contract_ids and throws if any group row is missing. 230 tests passing.
Analysis of pool saturation; proposed single batch statement or multi-row upsert in one transaction plus Deno test and benchmark. Payout details.
Asked whether the bounty is still open and funded at $70 and how payment is released after merge.
Resolved in PR #123: pre-flight selectIn on groups that throws for missing rows, then one bulk upsert with onConflict contract_id. Tests for 1 select plus 1 upsert. Payout address included.
